cards.headline: One open network for kirana procurement
cards.dek: DigiDukaan connects retailers, distributors and brands directly — 10K+ retailers and 35+ brands already live in the Hyderabad pilot.

cards.headline: FMCG brands back the push to modernise general trade
cards.dek: Major FMCG players join DigiDukaan to bring better pricing, schemes and margins to India's neighbourhood stores.

cards.headline: 300K bus and metro tickets booked every day
cards.dek: Transit ticketing runs inside the apps people already use, as the network crosses 500M cumulative transactions.

cards.headline: Uber enters B2B logistics in India on ONDC
cards.dek: Uber Direct launches through the network, opening on-demand delivery capacity to businesses of every size.

cards.headline: Loans, insurance and more, delivered over the network
cards.dek: ONDC is rolling out a full financial services suite — unsecured loans, business finance and insurance — within 18 months.

cards.headline: Flipkart enters food delivery through ONDC
cards.dek: A phased rollout across urban markets plugs Flipkart into the network's restaurant supply instead of a captive platform.
